metadata.project: Complete Astrological Chart Types Reference: The Definitive Technical Manual
metadata.description: Exhaustive technical reference of Western astrology chart types, mathematical formulas, geometric patterns, and specialized systems. Contains every calculation method, dependency relationship, and interpretive rule synthesized from extensive astrological research and analysis.
metadata.document_structure: Categorical hierarchy with full technical specifications

category_i_foundational_personal_bluepri.category_description: Primary charts and derivative techniques for understanding the innate self, soul purpose, karmic patterns, and base psychological potentials. These form the core mathematical foundation for all other astrological work.

technical_specifications.core_function: Geocentric snapshot of planetary positions relative to Earth at exact moment of birth. Represents the cosmic blueprint, genetic inheritance, and 'factory settings' of the individual.
technical_specifications.mathematical_basis: Spherical astronomy calculations using topocentric coordinates accounting for atmospheric refraction, nutation, and light-time correction for outer planets.
primary_uses: Understanding fundamental personality structure and psychological makeup
Identifying innate talents, abilities, and vocational aptitudes
Mapping life purpose, destiny, and karmic lessons
Establishing baseline for all predictive and derivative techniques

critical_data_requirements.birth_date: Gregorian calendar date (requires conversion to Julian Day Number)
critical_data_requirements.birth_time: Exact local mean time (precision to minute critical for house cusps)

birth_location.altitude: Above sea level (for atmospheric refraction correction)

house_system_options.placidus: Time-based quadrant system using semi-arc division (fails at extreme latitudes)
house_system_options.koch: Birthplace system focusing on self-actualization potential
house_system_options.regiomontanus: Space-based system dividing celestial equator (excellent for mundane)
house_system_options.whole_sign: Ancient system: entire sign = house (simplest, no interceptions)
house_system_options.topocentric: Empirical modification of Placidus for all latitudes

pros: Universally accepted foundation
Comprehensive personality analysis
Required for all derivative techniques
Rich historical interpretive tradition
cons: Static snapshot (doesn't show development)
Requires exact birth time for accuracy
Multiple house systems create interpretation conflicts
related_techniques: Chart Shapes (Bowl, Bucket, Splash, Locomotive, See-Saw)

technical_specifications.core_function: Mathematical recalibration of natal chart placing North Lunar Node at 0° Aries (the 'Draconic Zero Point'). Represents soul purpose, karmic patterns, and higher self expression.

calculation_method.step_1: Calculate natal North Node's true longitude (corrected for nutation)
calculation_method.step_2: Determine arc distance: Arc = Natal North Node Longitude (since 0° Aries = 0°)
calculation_method.step_3: Apply to all points: Draconic Longitude = (Natal Longitude - Arc) mod 360
calculation_method.note: Preserves all natal aspects and planetary relationships but changes zodiac positions

primary_uses: Exploring soul-level purpose and spiritual destiny
Identifying karmic patterns and past life influences
Draconic Synastry: analyzing karmic soul connections between individuals
Understanding 'higher self' expression vs. personality expression

interpretation_focus.draconic_sun: Soul's core identity and spiritual purpose
interpretation_focus.draconic_moon: Soul's emotional nature and unconscious patterns
interpretation_focus.draconic_ascendant: How soul approaches incarnation and learns lessons
interpretation_focus.aspect_patterns: Karmic relationship dynamics between soul functions

pros: Provides profound spiritual perspective on life path
Reveals pre-incarnation soul agreements
Powerful for understanding 'fated' relationships
cons: Esoteric and abstract interpretation
Difficult to integrate with tangible reality of natal chart
Less standardized interpretive framework
dependencies: Natal Chart (for all planetary positions and aspects)
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Best used as complementary layer to natal chart. Draconic positions show 'why' soul chose particular natal configuration.

technical_specifications.core_function: Nine separate birth charts calculated for each natal planet (excluding Sun), representing distinct archetypal sub-personalities within the psyche. Each has its own Ascendant, houses, and planetary positions.

calculation_methodology.core_principle: Each persona chart is 'born' when transiting Sun first conjoins natal planet after birth

step_by_step.step_1: For each natal planet (Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto), note exact zodiac position
step_by_step.step_2: Using solar ephemeris, find first date AFTER birth when Sun reaches same degree/minute as natal planet
step_by_step.step_3: Calculate exact time on that date when Sun is precisely at target degree (requires astronomical calculation)
step_by_step.step_5: Cast full natal chart for that calculated date, time, and location = Persona Chart for that planet

calculation_methodology.note: All nine persona charts occur within first year of life as Sun completes first solar cycle

archetypal_personalities.moon_persona: The Nurturer / Inner Child: emotional security, feminine principle, feeling world
archetypal_personalities.mercury_persona: The Communicator / Analyst: intellect, communication, daily interaction, mental processes
archetypal_personalities.venus_persona: The Lover / Artist: sensuality, pleasure, relationship style, values, aesthetics, harmony
archetypal_personalities.mars_persona: The Warrior / Pioneer: self-assertion, drive, aggression, courage, how you fight battles
archetypal_personalities.jupiter_persona: The Philosopher / Teacher: search for meaning, faith, expansion, optimism, 'inner therapist'
archetypal_personalities.saturn_persona: The Authority / Architect: discipline, responsibility, structure, life lessons, limitations
archetypal_personalities.uranus_persona: The Rebel / Innovator: freedom, innovation, sudden change, liberation, individuality
archetypal_personalities.neptune_persona: The Mystic / Visionary: dreams, illusion, spirituality, transcendence, artistic inspiration
archetypal_personalities.pluto_persona: The Transformer / Shaman: power, obsession, subconscious, regeneration, death/rebirth cycles

interpretation_guidelines.rule_1: Interpret each persona chart as complete natal chart for that sub-personality
interpretation_guidelines.rule_2: Persona Sun is always in same zodiac degree as natal planet but in NEW house position
interpretation_guidelines.rule_3: Persona Ascendant represents how this sub-personality approaches world
interpretation_guidelines.rule_4: Persona Midheaven shows potential destiny/achievement path for this archetype
interpretation_guidelines.rule_5: Planetary aspects within persona chart show internal dynamics of that sub-personality
interpretation_guidelines.special_emphasis: The persona chart of your natal Ascendant ruler is particularly significant

primary_uses: Deep psychological analysis of specific planetary complexes
Understanding nuanced expression of different facets of psyche
Analyzing planetary energies that are heavily activated by transits/progressions
Persona Synastry: comparing one person's persona chart to another's
pros: Provides extraordinary depth and granularity in psychological analysis
Gives 'voice' to planetary energies overshadowed in natal synthesis
Can be used predictively via transits to specific persona charts
cons: Can lead to excessive fragmentation if not synthesized back to whole
Modern niche technique without long historical tradition
Adds significant complexity (interpreting 9 extra charts)
technical_specifications.integration_notes: The natal chart itself represents the 'Sun Persona.' The Moon Persona is sometimes called the 'Yin Chart,' complementing the natal 'Yang Chart.'

technical_specifications.core_function: Mathematical transformation of natal chart by multiplying all positions by harmonic number 'n' to examine specific life themes, hidden potentials, and qualitative energy of aspects.

mathematical_foundation.explanation: Multiplication creates 'overtones' of natal chart, like musical harmonics. Conjunctions in harmonic chart represent strong 'n-type' energy.
mathematical_foundation.aspect_relationship: Planets in p-aspect (360°/n) in natal chart become CONJUNCTIONS in nth harmonic chart

common_harmonics_interpretation.h1: Natal Chart: fundamental tone, conscious personality
common_harmonics_interpretation.h4: Structure/Work: discipline, tangible results, square-based challenge
common_harmonics_interpretation.h5: Creativity/Virtuosity: personal genius, artistry, quintile (72°) emphasis
common_harmonics_interpretation.h6: Service/Health: daily routines, healing, sextile-based adjustment
common_harmonics_interpretation.h7: Inspiration/Fate: mystical insight, destiny, septile (≈51.43°) emphasis
common_harmonics_interpretation.h8: Transformation/Intensity: shared resources, crisis, octile (45°) emphasis
common_harmonics_interpretation.h9: Destiny/Philosophy: higher mind, spiritual fruition, novile (40°) emphasis
common_harmonics_interpretation.h16: Crisis/Power: transformation through crisis, intense focus

ninth_harmonic_specialization.name: Ninth Harmonic (H9) / Novienic Chart / Navamsa (Vedic D9)
ninth_harmonic_specialization.western_interpretation: Inner nature, deeper destiny, spiritual fruition, 'what we are headed toward'
ninth_harmonic_specialization.vedic_interpretation: Marriage, partnership potential, spiritual fulfillment (considered essential for relationship analysis)
ninth_harmonic_specialization.aspect_focus: Novile (40°) and binovile (80°) aspects represent fate, inspiration, ultimate purpose
ninth_harmonic_specialization.key_principle: Conjunctions in H9 chart reveal powerful subconscious drives masked by outer personality

interpretation_rules.rule_1: Focus on CONJUNCTIONS in harmonic chart (represent emphasized themes)
interpretation_rules.rule_2: Signs/houses in harmonic chart are recalculated from new positions (not natal signs/houses)
interpretation_rules.rule_3: NEVER mix or compare aspects between different harmonic charts (mathematically incompatible)
interpretation_rules.rule_4: Soft aspects in natal may appear as hard aspects in certain harmonics (revealing hidden tension)
interpretation_rules.rule_5: Hard aspects in natal may appear as soft aspects in harmonics (showing constructive potential)

technical_warnings: Sign and house interpretation in harmonics is debated; some practitioners focus solely on aspect patterns
Harmonics above H16 require extreme precision (sub-degree accuracy)
Different harmonic series emphasize different aspect families
primary_uses: Revealing specialized talents and hidden potentials not evident in natal
Understanding qualitative energy of aspects (e.g., constructive vs. challenging squares)
Examining specific life themes (creativity in H5, relationships in H7, etc.)
Relationship analysis through harmonic compatibility
pros: Unlocks incredible depth and specificity beyond natal chart
Shows constructive potential of challenging natal aspects
Mathematically precise and reproducible
cons: Highly abstract and complex interpretation
Can lead to fragmentation if overused
Advanced technique with less standardized interpretation
dependencies: Natal Chart (mathematical source for all positions)
technical_specifications.calculation_tools: Specialized astrology software or manual calculation with precision ephemeris

charts.chart_name: Prenatal Epoch Chart (Trutine of Hermes / Conception Chart)

technical_specifications.core_function: Controversial technique based on ancient 'Trutine of Hermes' principle linking Moon's position at conception/birth with Ascendant/Descendant at birth/conception. Seeks to identify significant prenatal moment.

historical_basis.ancient_principle: 'The Ascendant at birth is the place of the Moon at the Epoch, and the Ascendant or its opposite point at the Epoch was the place of the Moon at birth.'
historical_basis.traditional_use: Birth time rectification and determining potential sex of native
historical_basis.modern_view: Esoteric exploration of soul's incarnation or pre-birth conditions

calculation_methods.prenatal_solar_epoch: Chart for last New Moon before birth, calculated for birth place
calculation_methods.trutine_of_hermes: Complex calculation based on Moon's phase (increasing/decreasing light) and position relative to horizon at birth, working backward on ~273-day (9-month) cycle
calculation_methods.variant_methods: Multiple conflicting calculation systems exist with different rules

interpretation_approaches.rectification_tool: Used to verify/correct birth time by working backward from known life events
interpretation_approaches.soul_incarnation_chart: Interpreted as chart of soul's entry point or pre-birth agreement
interpretation_approaches.karmic_indicator: Shows conditions and agreements preceding physical birth

primary_uses: Birth time rectification when records are uncertain
Exploring philosophical questions of destiny and pre-birth conditions
In traditional astrology: predicting sex of child and vitality
pros: Fascinating traditional technique with precise mathematical basis
Powerful rectification tool in skilled hands
Addresses profound questions of destiny and incarnation
cons: Considered highly speculative in mainstream astrology
Multiple conflicting calculation methods
Practical application is debated and controversial
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Primarily used by traditional and esoteric astrologers. Not part of standard modern astrological practice.

category_ii_relationship_synergy.category_description: Charts and techniques for analyzing dynamics, compatibility, and combined entity of partnerships (romantic, business, familial, etc.). These methods synthesize two or more natal charts.

technical_specifications.core_function: Overlay of two natal charts to compare planetary placements and aspects BETWEEN them. Shows interactive dynamics and chemistry.

visualization_methods.bi_wheel: Inner wheel = Chart A, outer wheel = Chart B (most common)
visualization_methods.aspect_table: Grid showing all aspects between planets in both charts
visualization_methods.composite_table: List of inter-chart conjunctions, oppositions, squares, etc.

house_overlay_analysis.principle: Planets from one chart falling into houses of other chart
house_overlay_analysis.example: His Sun in her 7th house emphasizes partnership
house_overlay_analysis.interpretation: Shows areas of life activated by the relationship

primary_uses: Analyzing chemistry and attraction in any relationship
Identifying points of harmony and potential conflict
Understanding why certain dynamics exist in relationship
Compatibility assessment for romance, business, or family
pros: Excellent for detailed analysis of interpersonal dynamics
Direct and intuitive to interpret
Reveals 'why' behind relationship feelings and patterns
cons: Shows interaction but not combined entity of relationship
Can create overwhelming number of aspects to interpret
Doesn't show how relationship evolves over time
dependencies: Two complete Natal Charts (with accurate birth times)
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Most effective when combined with Composite or Davison chart for complete relationship picture.

technical_specifications.core_function: Creation of new, third chart by calculating mathematical midpoints between two people's planets and angles. Represents 'birth chart of the relationship' itself.

angle_calculation.reference_place_method: Calculate chart for midpoint location/time (variant method)

calculation_method.house_systems: Placidus, Koch, or Whole Sign applied to composite positions

interpretation_approach.principle: Interpret as natal chart for the relationship entity
interpretation_approach.composite_sun: Relationship's core identity, purpose, and vitality
interpretation_approach.composite_moon: Relationship's emotional nature, needs, and private face
interpretation_approach.composite_ascendant: How relationship appears to world, its 'face'
interpretation_approach.planetary_aspects: Internal dynamics and challenges within relationship structure

primary_uses: Understanding relationship's purpose and combined energy
Seeing how partnership functions as unit in world
Identifying relationship's strengths and challenges as entity
Assessing long-term potential and evolution of partnership
pros: Reveals essence and destiny of partnership beyond individual compatibility
Shows what relationship itself is meant to create or experience
Provides single chart representing relationship entity
cons: Base composite chart is static
Relationship evolution seen through transits/progressions to composite
Midpoint vs. reference place calculation debate
dependencies: Two complete Natal Charts (for midpoint calculations)

variant_methods.time_space_midpoint: Chart calculated for midpoint in time AND space between births
variant_methods.weighted_composite: Midpoints weighted by planetary dignity or speed

technical_specifications.core_function: Single chart calculated for EXACT midpoint in TIME and SPACE between two births. Treats relationship as if 'born' at that moment and place.

calculation_method.chart_casting: Calculate natal chart for midpoint time at midpoint location

variant_calculations.corrected_davison: Accounts for time zone differences and daylight saving
variant_calculations.reference_place: Uses one person's location instead of midpoint

interpretation_approach.principle: Interpret as complete natal chart for the relationship
interpretation_approach.advantage: Has its own Ascendant and houses derived from midpoint location/time
interpretation_approach.focus: Relationship's incarnation at specific time/place, with emphasis on timing events within relationship

primary_uses: Similar to Composite chart but with stronger emphasis on relationship's 'incarnation'
Timing events within relationship (using transits to Davison chart)
Some astrologers prefer for its more 'natal-like' qualities
pros: Provides relationship with its own complete natal-like chart
Useful for timing relationship events
Midpoint in time/space feels conceptually satisfying
cons: Multiple calculation methods create confusion and inconsistency
Debate over which variant is most accurate
Less commonly used than midpoint composite
dependencies: Two complete Natal Charts (with precise time and location data)
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Often compared/contrasted with midpoint Composite chart. Some astrologers use both.

technical_specifications.core_function: Analysis of how relationship evolves by comparing individually progressed charts. Shows how each person's inner growth affects their interaction over time.

calculation_layers.layer_1: Progressed-to-Natal: One partner's progressed planets to other's natal chart
calculation_layers.layer_2: Progressed-to-Progressed: Both partners' progressed charts compared
calculation_layers.layer_3: Progressed House Overlays: One partner's progressed planets in other's natal houses

key_planetary_focus.progressed_venus: Evolving love style, values, and relationship needs
key_planetary_focus.progressed_moon: Changing emotional needs and comfort patterns
key_planetary_focus.progressed_mercury: Evolution of communication style and intellectual connection
key_planetary_focus.progressed_mars: Changing assertion style, sexual expression, and conflict approach

primary_uses: Understanding changing dynamics in long-term relationship
Explaining why connections deepen, fade, or transform over years
Timing relationship phases and developmental chapters
Analyzing relationship evolution beyond static natal synastry
pros: Provides dynamic, evolving view of relationship
Excellent for understanding timing and phases within partnership
Explains relationship changes as individuals grow
cons: Adds significant complexity to relationship analysis
Requires accurate progressed charts for both people
Multiple layers can be challenging to synthesize
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Most meaningful for long-term relationships where both individuals have undergone significant progression changes.

technical_specifications.core_function: Shows how energy of relationship itself (represented by natal composite chart) evolves and matures over time. Reflects changing atmosphere, purpose, and shared experiences.
technical_specifications.calculation_method: 1) Calculate standard midpoint composite chart. 2) Apply secondary progression ('day for year' technique) to this composite as if it were birth chart.

interpretation_approach.principle: Interpret progressed positions relative to natal composite positions
interpretation_approach.focus: Changing atmosphere and developmental phases of relationship
interpretation_approach.key_transits: Transits to progressed composite show external influences on relationship evolution

primary_uses: Assessing current and future phases of relationship as unified entity
Understanding how relationship's purpose and energy matures
Identifying periods of harmony, challenge, or redefinition for partnership
pros: Offers profound insight into life cycle of relationship itself
Shows relationship's developmental path independent of individual growth
cons: Highly advanced, abstract technique
Best interpreted by comparing to natal composite foundation
Less commonly used than other relationship techniques
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Represents the relationship's own 'life progression' separate from individuals' progressions.

technical_specifications.core_function: Relationship analysis using Draconic charts instead of natal charts. Examines soul-level, karmic connections between individuals.
technical_specifications.calculation_method: Calculate Draconic charts for both individuals, then compare using standard synastry techniques.

interpretation_focus.principle: Reveals karmic, soul-level recognition and connection
interpretation_focus.draconic_conjunctions: Strong soul recognition and past life connections
interpretation_focus.draconic_aspects: Soul lessons and agreements being worked out
interpretation_focus.contrast_with_natal: Natal synastry shows personality interaction; Draconic shows soul connection

primary_uses: Analyzing karmic, past life connections in relationships
Understanding 'fated' or 'soulmate' quality of certain relationships
Identifying soul lessons being worked out through relationship
pros: Reveals profound spiritual dimensions of relationship
Explains intense, 'fated' feelings beyond personality compatibility
cons: Esoteric and abstract
Should be used with natal synastry for complete picture
dependencies: Two Draconic Charts (derived from two Natal Charts)
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Most meaningful when there are strong Draconic connections AND supportive natal synastry.

category_iii_predictive_cyclical_timing.category_description: Charts and techniques for forecasting themes, activating natal potentials, and timing events through celestial cycles and symbolic progression methods.

technical_specifications.core_function: Overlay of current, real-time positions of planets in sky onto individual's natal or progressed chart. Shows how current celestial energies activate personal chart.
technical_specifications.visualization: Typically bi-wheel: inner ring = natal chart, outer ring = transiting planets
technical_specifications.aspect_focus: Aspects between transiting planets and natal/progressed planets

planetary_significance.fast_moving: Moon (2.5 days/sign): Daily mood, emotional fluctuations
planetary_significance.personal_planets: Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars (weeks-months): Personal initiatives, relationships
planetary_significance.outer_planets: Uranus, Neptune, Pluto (years-decades): Generational shifts, transformation

technical_specifications.station_emphasis: When transiting planet stations (changes direction), its influence intensifies 2-3 weeks around exact station
primary_uses: Prediction and timing of events and periods
Understanding daily, monthly, yearly cycles and influences
Identifying periods of opportunity, challenge, or change
Timing actions based on favorable/unfavorable transits
pros: Essential for understanding current influences
Highly dynamic and constantly changing
Excellent for short-term planning and timing
cons: Represents short-term influences only
Must be synthesized with enduring natal patterns
Can be overwhelming with multiple simultaneous transits
dependencies: Natal Chart (or Progressed Chart as base)
technical_specifications.integration_notes: Most effective when layered with progressions and solar arcs for complete timing picture.

technical_specifications.core_function: Symbolic progression where one day after birth represents one year of life. Shows personal evolution and development of natal blueprint.

calculation_method.basic_principle: Progressed Position = Natal Position + (Natal Daily Motion × Years of Life)
calculation_method.simplified_version: Add 1° per year to Sun's position (approximately), add proportional motion to other planets
calculation_method.precise_calculation: Requires exact daily motion from ephemeris for each planet

key_progressed_planets.progressed_moon: Changes sign every ~2.5 years = changing emotional focus and needs
key_progressed_planets.progressed_sun: Changes sign every ~30 years = major identity shifts and life chapters
key_progressed_planets.progressed_ascendant: Changes every ~30 years = changing approach to life and self-presentation
key_progressed_planets.progressed_mercury_venus_mars: Sign changes mark shifts in communication, values, and drive

aspect_interpretation.focus: Aspects formed between progressed planets and natal positions
aspect_interpretation.orb: Tight orb (0.5-1°) as progressed planets move slowly
aspect_interpretation.stationary_periods: When progressed planet stations, its influence is emphasized for years

primary_uses: Tracking slow, internal personality shifts and development
Understanding emotional development and changing interests
Identifying significant periods of growth or new beginnings
Timing internal readiness for external events shown by transits
pros: Excellent for understanding long-term personal growth
Symbolizes psychological and emotional maturation
Shows development of natal potentials over time
cons: Very slow-moving (major changes infrequent)
Complex to interpret in relation to natal chart
Different progression methods exist (secondary, tertiary, etc.)

variant_methods.solar_arc_progression: All planets progressed at Sun's rate (see separate entry)
